provenance.source: Supplied by the AzerDex owner for the P2-D proof of concept (uploaded image of the Tirisfal Glades world map).
provenance.note: The brief described a PNG source; the file actually received was WebP (1002x668) and is stored unmodified. No separate PNG source was provided.
provenance.licenseNote: The artwork appears to be Blizzard map art. docs/web/maps-and-assets.md currently forbids hosting it. Owner decision required before any public deployment or CDN publication.

calibration.note: Projection is exact by construction; registration against known landmarks has not been visually verified in a browser by the owner.
